label: main season
summary: E1 is weak indirect evidence (reliability class 7): a passing trader relayed an unverified warning and could identify neither a first-hand source nor a location. After only one visit, it has not met the national follow-up threshold for clearance. There is no qualifying evidence of absence to support cancellation, and the nearby recorded accident is within 1 km, not stated to be inside this area. Recommend another non-technical survey visit before deciding.
flags: On further survey, seek first-hand sources with knowledge of the area and clarify whether any report refers to this area. The zone flag and survey priority indicate where to survey, not evidence of contamination.

checks.detail: Further non-technical survey is always open.

E1.quote: A trader passing through the vereda said people should keep away from the area because of mines, but could not say who had seen anything, or where.
E1.note: This is a second-hand warning relayed by an outsider who cannot identify any first-hand source or location; it suggests possible EO but is weak indirect evidence.
